title: AOI: Turning Failed Trajectories into Training Signals for Autonomous Cloud Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2603.03378v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents offer a promising data-driven approach to automating Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), yet their enterprise deployment is constrained by three challenges: restricted access to proprietary data, unsafe action execution under permission-governed environments, and the inability of closed systems to improve from failures. We present AOI (Autonomous Operations Intelligence), a trainable multi-agent framework formulating automated operations as a structured trajectory learning problem under security constraints. Our approach integrates three key components. First, a trainable diagnostic system applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to distill expert-level knowledge into locally deployed open-source models, enabling preference-based learning without exposing sensitive data. translated_title: AOI：将失败轨迹转化为训练信号以实现自主云诊断
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体为自动化站点可靠性工程（SRE）提供了一种有前景的数据驱动方法，然而其企业级部署面临三大挑战：对专有数据的访问受限、在权限管控环境下执行操作的安全性问题，以及封闭系统无法从失败中学习改进。我们提出了AOI（自主运维智能，Autonomous Operations Intelligence），这是一个可训练的多智能体框架，将自动化运维形式化为安全约束下的结构化轨迹学习问题。我们的方法集成了三个关键组件：首先，一个可训练的诊断系统应用组相对策略优化（GRPO），将专家级知识蒸馏到本地部署的开源模型中，在不暴露敏感数据的前提下实现基于偏好的学习；其次，一个读写分离的执行架构将运维轨迹分解为观察、推理等阶段（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AOI可训练多智能体框架，通过GRPO将专家知识蒸馏到本地开源模型并结合读写分离的安全执行架构，把失败运维轨迹转化为训练信号，在安全约束下实现自主云诊断。
en_tdlr: AOI is a trainable multi-agent framework that distills expert knowledge into locally deployed open-source models via GRPO and turns failed operation trajectories into training signals, enabling secure and autonomous cloud diagnosis under permission constraints.
